checks.storageHint: Set S3_PRIVATE_BUCKET to a bucket that is NOT publicly readable (same R2 account and keys as S3_BUCKET).
checks.turnstileHint: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY. Without it the form relies on rate limits and a hidden honeypot field only.
checks.cleanupHint: Set CRON_SECRET. Vercel Cron then runs the job daily; on a VPS, call /api/cron/cleanup-submissions with it.
checks.mailHint: MAIL_DRIVER is "console", so emails are only written to the server log. Set MAIL_DRIVER=resend and RESEND_API_KEY.
